name: Docs Auditor
description: Audits product documentation against what actually shipped: compares the docs with the changelog, release notes and merged changes, and returns a list of stale, missing and wrong pages with the exact passage, the evidence and a drafted correction. Use when the user asks whether the docs are up to date, to check docs against a release or changelog, to find pages a new feature or rename made wrong, or to prepare docs updates before a launch. Do NOT use for writing a brand new help center from scratch (use help center writing skills) or for writing the changelog itself (use changelog-writer).
